user_authorization.context: Immediate reply to the proposed separate approval of exact WS-PFR-20260917-01 review transfer and WS-HC-20260917-01 harness correction up to a tested, independently review-ready correction state, without automatic merge or feature start.
user_authorization.interpretation: Approval of that limited execution scope; not a new product decision or an independent verdict.
user_authorization.provenance_limitation: Visible user message and immediate context; no fabricated expanded quote, digital signature, platform ID or exact timestamp.

authorized_executor.environment: The user-selected Codex coding-agent environment already used for WindowSafe.
authorized_executor.actual_tools_and_model_controls: Discover and record available shell/Git/GitHub/test tools and current authorized configuration at preflight. No invented capabilities.
authorized_executor.model_policy: Use sufficient available configurations inside this authorized environment. No cross-provider switch, new paid service or material cost increase is authorized.

allowed_execution.permission_note: Only required Foundation/harness/contract/test/evidence changes. The read-only CI permissions, immutable inputs, safety rules and product boundaries are not weakened.

transport_integrity.already_existing_identical_target: Verify exact bytes and record an idempotent transfer; do not recreate or modify.
transport_integrity.already_existing_different_target: STOP before overwrite. No replacement, invented ID or reclassification.
transport_integrity.historical_chat_escapes: Already decoded once in the supplied bound payload; do not decode, reserialize or reword it again.
transport_integrity.separate_sidecar_required: Record actual transport branch/commit/hash and authorization separately from the review JSON.
transport_integrity.canonical_main_transfer: Not performed by preparation and not authorized as a direct main write. Main inclusion remains pending separate integration authorization.

preflight: Verify package manifest, authorization, exact draft, result, residual and return-provenance bytes.
Read AGENTS.md and canonical context/engineering/reviews at the exact base commit; verify Foundation 1 and 2 blobs.
Immediately before mutation verify repository identity/visibility/remote, remote-main, local HEAD/worktree/index/untracked files and work-branch ownership.
Start from the bound nonempty baseline, not from the old EMPTY_REPOSITORY bootstrap condition. Stop for drift or unrelated work; no reset/stash/deletion of foreign changes.
Check collisions for the result path and new branch. Resume only demonstrably same-authorized work descended from this baseline; otherwise stop.
Before using any unfixed writer verify link-free output directory and leaf. Never clean up a foreign link automatically.
Use the pinned Python/test environment; do not bypass version/CI/contract gates or present component checks as full checks.
protected_boundaries: All existing foundation/inputs and foundation/sources files remain byte-identical; do not extend/rewrite the original bootstrap input manifest.

Persist this new authorization/provenance separately under appropriate Foundation evidence paths; keep an explicit mapping to package inputs instead of dumping historical source copies into the live repository.
Original WS-PFR-20260917-01 PASS remains bound only to its old commit. Its OPEN MINOR is not edited to RESOLVED.
The separately recorded validator residual is not added retrospectively to that review.
Product Definition/Approval, TFP r6, READY binding, T01-T05-R2, CPU thresholds and platform/performance preimplementation gates do not change.
A new correction subject and exact candidate SHA do not inherit old PASS. A fresh independent targeted review is required.

risk_and_integration.review_path: Targeted independent PROJECT_FOUNDATION_REVIEW of the new commit may also supply the technical pre-integration coverage; no duplicated identical full review.

STOP confirmation: no merge/main write, no epic/feature, no browser/profile, no publication/production.
